Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```rust title="Rust"
use crawlberg::interact;
use crawlberg::CrawlConfig;
use crawlberg::create_engine;
use crawlberg::PageAction;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() {
    let engine_config: CrawlConfig = serde_json::from_str("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}").expect("config should parse");
    let engine = create_engine(Some(engine_config)).expect("handle creation should succeed");
    let url = r#"https://example.com"#.to_string();
    let actions_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r##"[{"selector":"#open","type":"click"},{"selector":"#field","text":"test_data","type":"type"},{"selector":"#submit","type":"click"}]"##).unwrap();
    let actions = serde_json::from_value::<Vec<PageAction>>(actions_json).unwrap();
    let _ = interact(&engine, &url, actions).await;
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].action_index);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].action_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[0].success);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[1].action_index);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[1].action_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[1].success);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[2].action_index);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[2].action_type);
    println!("{:?}", result.action_results[2].success);
}
```
